claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lightweight, natural-looking finish and easy, smooth application.
Many reviewers highlight the high SPF as a major benefit for sun protection.
Several reviewers complain about the strong perfume scent being overpowering.
Some reviewers report shade-matching problems, especially for darker or specific undertones.
A few reviewers find the product too sheer or lacking in coverage, and some note the high price.
